user.title: OpenSpeedTest CLI
user.description: Configure speed tests via the OpenSpeedTest CLI tool. For Home Assistant Container and HA OS, keep the CLI in the config directory ({config_path}) so it survives container updates.

data.install_cli: Download CLI to the config directory

data_description.binary_path: Use a path inside the Home Assistant config directory so the CLI survives container updates.
data_description.install_cli: Downloads https://openspeedtest.ru/cli/openspeedtest-cli after checking host, size and script signature.
data_description.scan_interval: Minimum 900 seconds. Speed tests saturate the uplink and downlink while they run.
data_description.server_id: Leave empty to pick the lowest-latency server. Use --list-servers on the CLI to see IDs.
data_description.api_key: 64 hexadecimal characters from your OpenSpeedTest.ru account. Not placed on the process command line.

data_description.api_key: Leave empty to keep the current key. Enter a new 64-character hex key to replace it.
data_description.clear_api_key: Deletes the stored key. Turn off result submission first, or enter a new key in the same form.
